2026-10-10: fixes for the fifth independent S7 review (docs/verification/phrf-cmp-s7-independent-review5-20261010.md), commit a0683984 on work/phrf-s7-reconcile, not pushed.

D1: output_id is now recorded in stamp.json and the sealed meta/stamp. A substituted output-id is refused on every resume with StampMismatch(output_id), before admission or any cost change. Test: review5 D1, the review's 6-step reproducer.
Hardening: an existing output-id is never redrawn, and only 32 lowercase ASCII hex characters are accepted (test: review5 hardening).
D2: fatal throwables are recorded where they arise, before cleanup runs, and a jobFinished exception is attached with addSuppressed instead of replacing the job's throwable. Test: review5 D2, 37 s, feed throws OutOfMemoryError, jobFinished throws IllegalStateException; the marker stays and the resume gives AccountingUncertain.
Reverting all fixes together fails all 3 review5 tests; file restored and verified by SHA-256.
Gates, confirmed from the "Passed: Total" lines (no disconnect): phrfComparisonJVM Passed: Total 523, Failed 0, Passed 513, Skipped 10; phrfComparisonJS Passed: Total 246, Failed 0; scalafimCompileAll [success] in 528 s, 0 warnings.
Synthetic only. Targeted review pending.
